summary.text: Karen Camper is a Democratic state representative from Tennessee House District 87 who has served since 2008, has been House minority leader since 2018, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Karen Camper attended the University of Tennessee at Knoxville and later received an A.S. from the University of Albany-SUNY.
Ballotpedia says she has worked as a substitute teacher for the Memphis City School System, owns Key II Entertainment, and is a retired Chief Warrant Officer in the U.S. Army.
She assumed office in 2008 and began serving as state House minority leader in 2018.
For the 2023-2024 session Ballotpedia lists her on committees including Calendar and Rules, Commerce, House Ethics, Finance, Ways, and Means, and Transportation.
